annex.heading: Annex A. Adopted colophon decisions
annex.intro: This annex is informative. It reproduces the two adopted project decisions that this specification implements, as recorded in docs/COLOPHON.md. Each decision states what was chosen, the reasoning, the cost accepted, the alternatives rejected, and how the decision is verified.
